title: Decision Table: Replacement Share after Early-Fill Overrides (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, earlier early-fill overrides for the drug shrink what is replaced for lost, stolen or damaged medication: when two or more overrides of any type were granted for the drug in the last twelve months, the replacement supply is the reduced lost days multiplied by 0.5; when exactly one was, it is multiplied by 0.75; otherwise the reduced lost days are replaced in full.

The reduced lost days are the lost days after any days taken off, never below zero. The share is applied to them, and the replacement supply is rounded down to whole days, never below zero.

Overrides of any type — vacation supply, lost or stolen, dose change and emergency supply — granted on the benefit for the same drug in the last twelve months are counted.

## Decision table

| Overrides for the drug in the last twelve months | Share of the reduced lost days replaced |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.5 (50 percent) |
| Exactly one | 0.75 (75 percent) |
| None | In full |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; reduced lost days of 15)

| Overrides for the drug in the last twelve months | Working | Replacement supply |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 15 in full | 15 |
| 1 | 15 multiplied by 0.75 is 11.25, rounded down | 11 |
| 2 | 15 multiplied by 0.5 is 7.5, rounded down | 7 |
| 3 | 15 multiplied by 0.5 is 7.5, rounded down | 7 |

With reduced lost days of zero, the replacement supply is zero whatever the count.
